top.headline: Claude Code 2.1.314 adds write blocking and idle compaction
top.summary: Adds permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories, so Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse paths outside the working directories in every permission mode. Idle compaction arrives in VS Code and Claude Desktop's Code tab: a conversation of 200K+ tokens left idle is summarized, and the summary is used on your next message if the prompt cache has expired. Also adds gateway group routing and fixes several failures.
